newsitem.title: USA: Ill. Clinton nuclear plant seen restarting Jan 24.
newsitem.headline: Ill. Clinton nuclear plant seen restarting Jan 24.

text.p: Illinois Power Co said Monday that its 930 megawatt Clinton nuclear power plant will likely begin startup operations around January 24.

"It's an estimated startup date. It may take anywhere from three days to three weeks before it goes on-line," a company spokesman said, noting extensive testing of the turbine may delay the unit's return to the grid.
Operators were working on feedwater check valves, he said, adding these valves prevent reactor water from coming out of the containment during an accident.
The unit, in Clinton, Ill., was shut September 5 to correct a recirculation pump problem.
He noted that this work has been completed.
